info.name: NurseHandOver
info.description:
Postman collection for NurseHandOver — stateless SBAR generation.

No request headers are required (including Content-Type). Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8028).

**Setup**
1. Import this collection.
2. Start the service: `python main.py` in NurseHandOver (port 8028).
3. Run **Generate SBAR — full shift (3 patients)** for a complete request body.

request.description: Liveness probe. Returns service name, version, model, and UTC timestamp. No API key.

Full POST /summary/generate body: one shift, three patients covering critical / watch / stable chart shapes (vitals, medications, pending_orders, alerts, nurse_notes).

No request headers. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY on the server. Response status is always draft.

response.name: 200 OK — three SBAR drafts

request.description: Smallest valid request: shift_id, nurse_id, and one patient with only patient_id and name. Other chart fields default to empty.
